# Adobe Express Add-ons Documentation

> Official developer documentation and API reference for building Adobe Express add-ons.

For detailed documentation on any page below, request the URL with `Accept: text/markdown` header to receive LLM-optimized markdown.

## Overview

- [Overview](https://developer.adobe.com/express/add-ons/docs/references/index.md): Here you will find all of the technical references you'll need to help you throughout your add-on development.

## Add-on UI SDK

- [SDK Reference](https://developer.adobe.com/express/add-ons/docs/references/addonsdk/index.md): The Adobe Express add-on SDK Reference. [Adobe Express, Express Add-on SDK, Express Editor, Adobe Express, Add-on SDK, SDK, JavaScript, Extend, Extensibility, API, Add-on Manifest]
- [app](https://developer.adobe.com/express/add-ons/docs/references/addonsdk/addonsdk-app.md): Provides access to the Adobe Express host application's objects and methods to provide features such as content import and export through the [document object](app-document.md),...
- [currentUser](https://developer.adobe.com/express/add-ons/docs/references/addonsdk/app-current-user.md): Provides access to the currently logged in user.
- [devFlags](https://developer.adobe.com/express/add-ons/docs/references/addonsdk/app-dev-flags.md): This object contains flags which can be used to simulate certain behavior during development.
- [document](https://developer.adobe.com/express/add-ons/docs/references/addonsdk/app-document.md): Provides access to the methods needed for retrieving document metadata, importing content such as images, audio and video into the document, and for exporting content from the c...
- [oauth](https://developer.adobe.com/express/add-ons/docs/references/addonsdk/app-oauth.md): Provides access to the OAuth API methods needed for implementing the user authorization with OAuth 2.0 use case.
- [ui](https://developer.adobe.com/express/add-ons/docs/references/addonsdk/app-ui.md): Provides you with UI related values from the Adobe Express host application where the add-on is running, so you can do things such as detect the current locale or theme in use t...
- [instance](https://developer.adobe.com/express/add-ons/docs/references/addonsdk/addonsdk-instance.md): Represents the currently running add-on instance. This object is used to provide access to the clientStorage and manifest objects.
- [clientStorage](https://developer.adobe.com/express/add-ons/docs/references/addonsdk/instance-client-storage.md): The clientStorage object provides a reference to Client Storage in the currently running add-on.
- [manifest](https://developer.adobe.com/express/add-ons/docs/references/addonsdk/instance-manifest.md): The manifest object provides access to the manifest.json file entries of the add-on.
- [runtime](https://developer.adobe.com/express/add-ons/docs/references/addonsdk/instance-runtime.md): Represents the runtime of the current add-on.
- [dialog](https://developer.adobe.com/express/add-ons/docs/references/addonsdk/runtime-dialog.md): Represents the modal dialog presented to the user. This object can be used to manage the dialog, like closing it and sending results to the caller.
- [Add-on UI SDK Constants Reference](https://developer.adobe.com/express/add-ons/docs/references/addonsdk/addonsdk-constants.md): Complete technical specification for all Add-on UI SDK constants including import patterns, dual-access vs named-only exports, and detailed reference details. [Adobe Express, Add-on UI SDK, Constants Reference, API Reference, SDK Constants, Named Exports, Import Patterns, Type Safety, JavaScript, TypeScript, AppEvent, ColorPickerEvent, SupportedMimeTypes, EntrypointType, RenditionFormat, Range, Variant, ButtonType, Modal Dialogs, Document Export, Event Handling, Platform Detection, Editor Navigation, OAuth Authorization, Video Rendition, Color Picker, Dialog Types, MIME Types, Technical Specification, API Documentation, Constants Object, Dual Access, Named Only Exports]

## Document Sandbox

- [Document Sandbox Overview](https://developer.adobe.com/express/add-ons/docs/references/document-sandbox/index.md): An overview of the document sandbox used for content authoring with the Adobe Express Document APIs. [Adobe Express, Express Add-on SDK, Express Editor, Adobe Express, Add-on SDK, SDK, JavaScript, Extend, Extensibility, API, Add-on Manifest]
- [Communication APIs](https://developer.adobe.com/express/add-ons/docs/references/document-sandbox/communication/index.md): An introduction to the Communication APIs available in the document sandbox. [Adobe Express, Express Add-on SDK, Express Editor, Adobe Express, Add-on SDK, SDK, JavaScript, Extend, Extensibility, API, Add-on Manifest]
- [Web APIs](https://developer.adobe.com/express/add-ons/docs/references/document-sandbox/web/index.md): An overview of the Web APIs available as part of the document sandbox. [Adobe Express, Express Add-on SDK, Express Editor, Adobe Express, Add-on SDK, SDK, JavaScript, Extend, Extensibility, API, Add-on Manifest]
- [Document APIs](https://developer.adobe.com/express/add-ons/docs/references/document-sandbox/document-apis/index.md): An introduction to the Document APIs available in the document sandbox. [Adobe Express, Express Add-on SDK, Express Editor, Adobe Express, Add-on SDK, SDK, JavaScript, Extend, Extensibility, API, Add-on Manifest]
- [Classes](https://developer.adobe.com/express/add-ons/docs/references/document-sandbox/document-apis/classes/editor.md): Entry point for APIs that read or modify the document's content.
- [ActivePageNode](https://developer.adobe.com/express/add-ons/docs/references/document-sandbox/document-apis/classes/active-page-node.md): A PageNode represents a page in the document, a child of the root node of the document's "scenegraph" artwork tree (see ExpressRootNode).
- [AddOnData](https://developer.adobe.com/express/add-ons/docs/references/document-sandbox/document-apis/classes/add-on-data.md): AddOnData class provides APIs to read, write, remove private metadata to a Node. This metadata is accessible only to the add-on that has set it.
- [ArtboardList](https://developer.adobe.com/express/add-ons/docs/references/document-sandbox/document-apis/classes/artboard-list.md): ArtboardList represents an ordered list of ArtboardNodes, which are the children of one PageNode.
- [ArtboardNode](https://developer.adobe.com/express/add-ons/docs/references/document-sandbox/document-apis/classes/artboard-node.md): An ArtboardNode represents the topmost container of visual content within a PageNode.
- [AvailableFont](https://developer.adobe.com/express/add-ons/docs/references/document-sandbox/document-apis/classes/available-font.md): Font the current user has access or licensing permissions to create / edit content with.
- [BaseFont](https://developer.adobe.com/express/add-ons/docs/references/document-sandbox/document-apis/classes/base-font.md): Represents a font that is able to be rendered within this document. However, the user may not have edit permissions for all such fonts.
- [BaseNode](https://developer.adobe.com/express/add-ons/docs/references/document-sandbox/document-apis/classes/base-node.md): A "node" represents an object in the scenegraph, the document's visual content tree.
- [BitmapImage](https://developer.adobe.com/express/add-ons/docs/references/document-sandbox/document-apis/classes/bitmap-image.md): Represents a bitmap image resource. Use Editor.loadBitmapImage to create a BitmapImage, and then Editor.createImageContainer to display it in the document by creating a MediaCon...
- [ColorUtils](https://developer.adobe.com/express/add-ons/docs/references/document-sandbox/document-apis/classes/color-utils.md): Utility methods for working with color values.
- [ComplexShapeNode](https://developer.adobe.com/express/add-ons/docs/references/document-sandbox/document-apis/classes/complex-shape-node.md): A ComplexShapeNode is a complex prepackaged shape that appears as a leaf node in the UI, even if it is composed of multiple separate paths.
- [Context](https://developer.adobe.com/express/add-ons/docs/references/document-sandbox/document-apis/classes/context.md): Contains the user's current selection state, indicating the content they are focused on.
- [EllipseNode](https://developer.adobe.com/express/add-ons/docs/references/document-sandbox/document-apis/classes/ellipse-node.md): An EllipseNode represents an ellipse or circle shape in the scenegraph.
- [ExpressContext](https://developer.adobe.com/express/add-ons/docs/references/document-sandbox/document-apis/classes/express-context.md): Contains The Express specific APIs related to the current selection state.
- [ExpressEditor](https://developer.adobe.com/express/add-ons/docs/references/document-sandbox/document-apis/classes/express-editor.md): Entry point for Express specific APIs that read or modify the document's content.
- [ExpressRootNode](https://developer.adobe.com/express/add-ons/docs/references/document-sandbox/document-apis/classes/express-root-node.md): An ExpressRootNode represents the root node of the document's "scenegraph" artwork tree.
- [ExpressViewport](https://developer.adobe.com/express/add-ons/docs/references/document-sandbox/document-apis/classes/express-viewport.md): Represents the area of the canvas that is currently visible on-screen.
- [FillableNode](https://developer.adobe.com/express/add-ons/docs/references/document-sandbox/document-apis/classes/fillable-node.md): Base class for a Node that can have its own fill and stroke.
- [Fonts](https://developer.adobe.com/express/add-ons/docs/references/document-sandbox/document-apis/classes/fonts.md): The Fonts class provides methods to work with fonts.
- [GridCellNode](https://developer.adobe.com/express/add-ons/docs/references/document-sandbox/document-apis/classes/grid-cell-node.md): A GridCellNode represents the media aspect of a grid cell. Unlike MediaContainerNodes, grid cells cannot be translated or rotated directly and can't modify a mask shape.
- [GridLayoutNode](https://developer.adobe.com/express/add-ons/docs/references/document-sandbox/document-apis/classes/grid-layout-node.md): A GridLayoutNode represents a grid layout in the scenegraph. Currently, grids contain only images but in the future they may support other types of content as well.
- [GroupNode](https://developer.adobe.com/express/add-ons/docs/references/document-sandbox/document-apis/classes/group-node.md): A GroupNode represents a Group object in the scenegraph, which has a collection of generic children as well as a separate, optional vector mask child.
- [ImageRectangleNode](https://developer.adobe.com/express/add-ons/docs/references/document-sandbox/document-apis/classes/image-rectangle-node.md): ImageRectangleNode is a rectangular node that displays the image media part of a MediaContainerNode.
- [ItemList](https://developer.adobe.com/express/add-ons/docs/references/document-sandbox/document-apis/classes/item-list.md): ItemList represents an ordered list of API objects that are all children of the same parent node. It is most frequently encountered as ArtboardNode.children or GroupNode.children.
- [LineNode](https://developer.adobe.com/express/add-ons/docs/references/document-sandbox/document-apis/classes/line-node.md): A LineNode represents a simple vector line in the scenegraph – a single straight-line segment.
- [MediaContainerNode](https://developer.adobe.com/express/add-ons/docs/references/document-sandbox/document-apis/classes/media-container-node.md): A MediaContainerNode is a multi-node construct that displays media (such as images or video) with optional cropping and clipping to a shape mask.
- [MediaRectangleNode](https://developer.adobe.com/express/add-ons/docs/references/document-sandbox/document-apis/classes/media-rectangle-node.md): MediaRectangleNode is the base class for a rectangular node that represents the uncropped media within a MediaContainerNode.
- [Node](https://developer.adobe.com/express/add-ons/docs/references/document-sandbox/document-apis/classes/node.md): A Node represents an object in the scenegraph, the document's visual content tree.
- [PageList](https://developer.adobe.com/express/add-ons/docs/references/document-sandbox/document-apis/classes/page-list.md): PageList represents an ordered list of PageNodes, all of which are children of the root node of the document's "scenegraph" artwork tree (see ExpressRootNode).
- [PageNode](https://developer.adobe.com/express/add-ons/docs/references/document-sandbox/document-apis/classes/page-node.md): A PageNode represents a page in the document, a child of the root node of the document's "scenegraph" artwork tree (see ExpressRootNode).
- [PathNode](https://developer.adobe.com/express/add-ons/docs/references/document-sandbox/document-apis/classes/path-node.md): A PathNode represents a generic vector path shape in the scenegraph. Paths cannot be edited through this API yet, only read.
- [ReadOnlyItemList](https://developer.adobe.com/express/add-ons/docs/references/document-sandbox/document-apis/classes/read-only-item-list.md): ReadOnlyItemList represents an ordered list of API objects that are all children of the same parent node.
- [ReadOnlyMask](https://developer.adobe.com/express/add-ons/docs/references/document-sandbox/document-apis/classes/read-only-mask.md): A read-only view of a mask shape.
- [RectangleNode](https://developer.adobe.com/express/add-ons/docs/references/document-sandbox/document-apis/classes/rectangle-node.md): A RectangleNode represents a rectangle shape in the scenegraph.
- [RestrictedItemList](https://developer.adobe.com/express/add-ons/docs/references/document-sandbox/document-apis/classes/restricted-item-list.md): Base for ItemLists that restrict how items are added to the list, but freely allow items to be removed and reordered. The ItemList subclass adds more capabilities, however.
- [SolidColorShapeNode](https://developer.adobe.com/express/add-ons/docs/references/document-sandbox/document-apis/classes/solid-color-shape-node.md): A SolidColorShapeNode is a prepackaged shape with a single color property that appears as a leaf node in the UI, even if it is composed of multiple separate paths.
- [StandaloneTextContentModel](https://developer.adobe.com/express/add-ons/docs/references/document-sandbox/document-apis/classes/standalone-text-content-model.md): StandaloneTextContentModel represents a complete piece of text content contained within a single StandaloneTextNode.
- [StandaloneTextNode](https://developer.adobe.com/express/add-ons/docs/references/document-sandbox/document-apis/classes/standalone-text-node.md): A StandaloneTextNode represents text that is displayed entirely within one single frame in the scenegraph (in contrast to ThreadedTextNode, where text may flow across several se...
- [StrokableNode](https://developer.adobe.com/express/add-ons/docs/references/document-sandbox/document-apis/classes/strokable-node.md): Base class for a Node that can have its own stroke.
- [StrokeShapeNode](https://developer.adobe.com/express/add-ons/docs/references/document-sandbox/document-apis/classes/stroke-shape-node.md): A StrokeShapeNode is prepackaged shape that has a single stroke property and appears as a leaf node in the UI, even if it is composed of multiple separate paths.
- [TextContentModel](https://developer.adobe.com/express/add-ons/docs/references/document-sandbox/document-apis/classes/text-content-model.md): TextContentModel is an abstract base class representing a complete piece of text content. Use this model to get or modify the text string and the style ranges applied to it.
- [TextNode](https://developer.adobe.com/express/add-ons/docs/references/document-sandbox/document-apis/classes/text-node.md): TextNode is an abstract base class representing text displayed in the scenegraph, regardless of whether it's a fully self-contained StandaloneTextNode or one of multiple Threade...
- [TextNodeContentModel](https://developer.adobe.com/express/add-ons/docs/references/document-sandbox/document-apis/classes/text-node-content-model.md): Represents a complete piece of text content, which may be contained within a single StandaloneTextNode or split across multiple ThreadedTextNode frames for display.
- [ThreadedTextContentModel](https://developer.adobe.com/express/add-ons/docs/references/document-sandbox/document-apis/classes/threaded-text-content-model.md): ThreadedTextContentModel represents a complete piece of text content that is split across multiple ThreadedTextNode frames for display.
- [ThreadedTextList](https://developer.adobe.com/express/add-ons/docs/references/document-sandbox/document-apis/classes/threaded-text-list.md): ReadOnlyItemList represents an ordered list of API objects that are all children of the same parent node.
- [ThreadedTextNode](https://developer.adobe.com/express/add-ons/docs/references/document-sandbox/document-apis/classes/threaded-text-node.md): A ThreadedTextNode represents a text display frame in the scenegraph which is a subset of longer text that flows across multiple such "frames".
- [UnavailableFont](https://developer.adobe.com/express/add-ons/docs/references/document-sandbox/document-apis/classes/unavailable-font.md): Font the current user does not have access or licensing permissions to create / edit content with.
- [UnknownMediaRectangleNode](https://developer.adobe.com/express/add-ons/docs/references/document-sandbox/document-apis/classes/unknown-media-rectangle-node.md): UnknownMediaRectangleNode is a rectangular node that represents the uncropped media within a MediaContainerNode for cases where the media type is not yet supported by this API.
- [UnknownNode](https://developer.adobe.com/express/add-ons/docs/references/document-sandbox/document-apis/classes/unknown-node.md): An UnknownNode is a node with limited support and therefore treated as a leaf node.
- [VisualNode](https://developer.adobe.com/express/add-ons/docs/references/document-sandbox/document-apis/classes/visual-node.md): A "node" represents an object in the scenegraph, the document's visual content tree.
- [Interfaces](https://developer.adobe.com/express/add-ons/docs/references/document-sandbox/document-apis/interfaces/area-text-layout.md): Area text: both width and height are explicitly set. If text content is too long to fit, the end of the text will be clipped.
- [AutoHeightTextLayout](https://developer.adobe.com/express/add-ons/docs/references/document-sandbox/document-apis/interfaces/auto-height-text-layout.md): Auto-height text: Width is explicitly set, and text wraps to use as much vertical space as necessary to display the full content.
- [AutoWidthTextLayout](https://developer.adobe.com/express/add-ons/docs/references/document-sandbox/document-apis/interfaces/auto-width-text-layout.md): Auto-width, aka point text: both width and height are automatically determined based on the content.
- [BaseParagraphStyles](https://developer.adobe.com/express/add-ons/docs/references/document-sandbox/document-apis/interfaces/base-paragraph-styles.md): Base paragraph styles that can be applied to an entire paragraph atomically.
- [CharacterStyles](https://developer.adobe.com/express/add-ons/docs/references/document-sandbox/document-apis/interfaces/character-styles.md): Text styles that can be applied to any range of characters, even a short span like a single word.
- [CharacterStylesInput](https://developer.adobe.com/express/add-ons/docs/references/document-sandbox/document-apis/interfaces/character-styles-input.md): Variant of CharacterStyles with all style fields optional, used for applyCharacterStyles().
- [CharacterStylesRange](https://developer.adobe.com/express/add-ons/docs/references/document-sandbox/document-apis/interfaces/character-styles-range.md): A set of CharacterStyles along with the range of characters they apply to. Seen in the characterStyleRanges getter.
- [CharacterStylesRangeInput](https://developer.adobe.com/express/add-ons/docs/references/document-sandbox/document-apis/interfaces/character-styles-range-input.md): Variant of CharacterStylesRange with all style fields optional, along with the range of characters they apply to.
- [Color](https://developer.adobe.com/express/add-ons/docs/references/document-sandbox/document-apis/interfaces/color.md): Represents an RGBA color value.
- [ColorFill](https://developer.adobe.com/express/add-ons/docs/references/document-sandbox/document-apis/interfaces/color-fill.md): Represents a solid-color fill.
- [CommonResizeOptions](https://developer.adobe.com/express/add-ons/docs/references/document-sandbox/document-apis/interfaces/common-resize-options.md): An interface for arbitrary resize operations regardless of whether given a width or height when using Node.resize.
- [ContainerNode](https://developer.adobe.com/express/add-ons/docs/references/document-sandbox/document-apis/interfaces/container-node.md): Interface for any node that contains an entirely generic collection of children.
- [CreateRenditionOptions](https://developer.adobe.com/express/add-ons/docs/references/document-sandbox/document-apis/interfaces/create-rendition-options.md): Experimental
- [CreateRenditionResult](https://developer.adobe.com/express/add-ons/docs/references/document-sandbox/document-apis/interfaces/create-rendition-result.md): Experimental
- [Fill](https://developer.adobe.com/express/add-ons/docs/references/document-sandbox/document-apis/interfaces/fill.md): Base interface representing any fill in the scenegraph. See FillableNode.
- [IFillableNode](https://developer.adobe.com/express/add-ons/docs/references/document-sandbox/document-apis/interfaces/i-fillable-node.md): Interface for FillableNode and any other nodes with a similar fill property that do not directly inherit from the FillableNode class.
- [IMediaContainerNode](https://developer.adobe.com/express/add-ons/docs/references/document-sandbox/document-apis/interfaces/i-media-container-node.md): Interface for nodes that contain media.
- [INodeBounds](https://developer.adobe.com/express/add-ons/docs/references/document-sandbox/document-apis/interfaces/i-node-bounds.md): An interface for the bounds of a Node.
- [IRectangularNode](https://developer.adobe.com/express/add-ons/docs/references/document-sandbox/document-apis/interfaces/i-rectangular-node.md): Interface for nodes with width and height properties.
- [IStrokableNode](https://developer.adobe.com/express/add-ons/docs/references/document-sandbox/document-apis/interfaces/i-strokable-node.md): Interface for StrokableNode and any other nodes with a similar stroke property that do not directly inherit from the StrokableNode class. (See ArtboardNode, for example).
- [IVisualNodeBounds](https://developer.adobe.com/express/add-ons/docs/references/document-sandbox/document-apis/interfaces/i-visual-node-bounds.md): An interface for the bounds of a VisualNode.
- [ListItem](https://developer.adobe.com/express/add-ons/docs/references/document-sandbox/document-apis/interfaces/list-item.md): Base interface for any item that can be stored in an ItemList (typically a Node type).
- [OrderedListStyleInput](https://developer.adobe.com/express/add-ons/docs/references/document-sandbox/document-apis/interfaces/ordered-list-style-input.md): Interface for specifying an ordered list style, such as a numbered list.
- [ParagraphStyles](https://developer.adobe.com/express/add-ons/docs/references/document-sandbox/document-apis/interfaces/paragraph-styles.md): Text styles that must be applied to an entire paragraph atomically.
- [ParagraphStylesInput](https://developer.adobe.com/express/add-ons/docs/references/document-sandbox/document-apis/interfaces/paragraph-styles-input.md): A variant of ParagraphStyles with all style fields optional, used for applyParagraphStyles().
- [ParagraphStylesRange](https://developer.adobe.com/express/add-ons/docs/references/document-sandbox/document-apis/interfaces/paragraph-styles-range.md): A set of ParagraphStyles along with the text range they apply to. Returned by the paragraphStyleRanges getter.
- [ParagraphStylesRangeInput](https://developer.adobe.com/express/add-ons/docs/references/document-sandbox/document-apis/interfaces/paragraph-styles-range-input.md): A variant of ParagraphStylesRange with all style fields optional, along with the text range they apply to.
- [Point](https://developer.adobe.com/express/add-ons/docs/references/document-sandbox/document-apis/interfaces/point.md): Represents a 2D position.
- [Rect](https://developer.adobe.com/express/add-ons/docs/references/document-sandbox/document-apis/interfaces/rect.md)
- [RectangleGeometry](https://developer.adobe.com/express/add-ons/docs/references/document-sandbox/document-apis/interfaces/rectangle-geometry.md)
- [RemoveListStyleInput](https://developer.adobe.com/express/add-ons/docs/references/document-sandbox/document-apis/interfaces/remove-list-style-input.md): Interface for removing a list style.
- [ReplaceMediaWithEditedImageOptions](https://developer.adobe.com/express/add-ons/docs/references/document-sandbox/document-apis/interfaces/replace-media-with-edited-image-options.md): Experimental
- [RescaleProportionalToHeightOptions](https://developer.adobe.com/express/add-ons/docs/references/document-sandbox/document-apis/interfaces/rescale-proportional-to-height-options.md): An interface for rescaling the node based on a given height when using Node.resize.
- [RescaleProportionalToWidthOptions](https://developer.adobe.com/express/add-ons/docs/references/document-sandbox/document-apis/interfaces/rescale-proportional-to-width-options.md): An interface for rescaling the node based on a given width when using Node.resize.
- [ResizeUsingHeightOptions](https://developer.adobe.com/express/add-ons/docs/references/document-sandbox/document-apis/interfaces/resize-using-height-options.md): An interface for resizing the node based on a given height when using Node.resize.
- [ResizeUsingWidthOptions](https://developer.adobe.com/express/add-ons/docs/references/document-sandbox/document-apis/interfaces/resize-using-width-options.md): An interface for resizing the node based on a given width when using Node.resize.
- [SolidColorStroke](https://developer.adobe.com/express/add-ons/docs/references/document-sandbox/document-apis/interfaces/solid-color-stroke.md): Represents a solid-color stroke, with optional dashes.
- [Stroke](https://developer.adobe.com/express/add-ons/docs/references/document-sandbox/document-apis/interfaces/stroke.md): Base interface representing any stroke in the scenegraph. See StrokableNode.
- [StyleRange](https://developer.adobe.com/express/add-ons/docs/references/document-sandbox/document-apis/interfaces/style-range.md): Represents a range of characters defined by a length (and implicitly started at the end of the previous range).
- [TextContent](https://developer.adobe.com/express/add-ons/docs/references/document-sandbox/document-apis/interfaces/text-content.md): Experimental
- [TextFrameAreaGeometry](https://developer.adobe.com/express/add-ons/docs/references/document-sandbox/document-apis/interfaces/text-frame-area-geometry.md): Geometry for an area text frame in pixels.
- [TextRange](https://developer.adobe.com/express/add-ons/docs/references/document-sandbox/document-apis/interfaces/text-range.md): A range of text in a TextContentModel, specified in characters.
- [UnorderedListStyleInput](https://developer.adobe.com/express/add-ons/docs/references/document-sandbox/document-apis/interfaces/unordered-list-style-input.md): Interface for specifying an unordered list style, such as a bullet list.
- [UnsupportedTextLayout](https://developer.adobe.com/express/add-ons/docs/references/document-sandbox/document-apis/interfaces/unsupported-text-layout.md): Represents a text layout the API does not yet support setting or reading the details of.
- [Constants](https://developer.adobe.com/express/add-ons/docs/references/document-sandbox/document-apis/constants/overview.md): The Constants namespace groups together the enumerations used by the Document APIs.
- [ArrowHeadType](https://developer.adobe.com/express/add-ons/docs/references/document-sandbox/document-apis/enumerations/arrow-head-type.md): Do not depend on the literal numeric values of these constants, as they may change. Always reference the enum identifiers in your code.
- [BlendMode](https://developer.adobe.com/express/add-ons/docs/references/document-sandbox/document-apis/enumerations/blend-mode.md): Do not depend on the literal numeric values of these constants, as they may change. Always reference the enum identifiers in your code.
- [CreateRenditionFormat](https://developer.adobe.com/express/add-ons/docs/references/document-sandbox/document-apis/enumerations/create-rendition-format.md): Experimental
- [EditorEvent](https://developer.adobe.com/express/add-ons/docs/references/document-sandbox/document-apis/enumerations/editor-event.md): This enum represents the supported editor events.
